highest_reported.source: Duchi, Commentary on 'Towards a Noncommutative Arithmetic-Geometric Mean Inequality' (COLT 2012), together with AlphaEvolve arXiv:2511.02864v1 §6.47's all-identity upper-bound example and its report of no counterexample at the selected (4,4,3), Schatten-2 setting.
highest_reported.reproduction_status: The all-identity witness is independently reconstructed and exactly verified at ratio 1. The paper's AI search report is not a witness for a value below 1 and gives no proof of optimality.

best_human.source: John C. Duchi, COLT 2012 commentary on the inside-sum variant; all four matrices set to I3 gives equal with- and without-replacement means.
best_human.provenance: Traditional mathematical construction. The tuple of identity matrices is explicit and independently reconstructed; no AI contribution is involved in this baseline.
best_human.evidence_state: Exact rational input; exact PSD minors; all product norms are sqrt(3), so the ratio is exactly 1.

best_public.source: Duchi's identity-matrix upper-bound example, as restated in AlphaEvolve arXiv:2511.02864v1 §6.47; the source reports that AlphaEvolve found no value below this bound in its tested configurations, which include this parameter/norm choice.
best_public.provenance: The 2025 paper reports AI-assisted search but does not present the identity tuple as a new AI construction. The exact score-1 witness is the traditional all-identity example and is separately reproduced here.
best_public.evidence_state: The value 1 is exactly attained by the saved identity witness. No proof that the infimum is at least 1 for this fixed configuration was found.

best_reproduced.verification_method: Exact rational complex multiplication, exact Hermitian PSD checks by all principal minors, integer-square-root intervals for all Frobenius norms, and exact cancellation of the all-identical product means.

frozen_human_baseline.endpoint_policy: Freeze the exact mathematical ratio H=1 for compatibility score H/J.
frozen_human_baseline.evidence_state: All 280 products equal I3 and have Frobenius norm sqrt(3), so the two means are exactly equal.

compatibility_score.note: The task minimizes J. A score above 1 means improvement over the frozen human witness and does not by itself establish a counterexample to the conjecture unless J<1 is certified.

optimality_status.evidence: AlphaEvolve arXiv:2511.02864v1 §6.47 says m>=4 is open and includes (4,4,3) with Schatten 2 in its search list. A search that finds no counterexample is not a proof that the infimum is at least 1.
optimality_status.limitations: The 2020 and 2026 Recht-Re results concern a norm outside the sum and do not establish the Duchi inside-sum inequality. The 2026 Evidence Press result is an unrefereed candidate with no unaffiliated rerun recorded.

Duchi_commentary.author: John C. Duchi
Duchi_commentary.note: The commentary is part of the COLT volume; Duchi defines with- and without-replacement expectations and proposes putting each product norm inside the sum.

outside_sum_counterexample.title: Recht-Re Noncommutative Arithmetic-Geometric Mean Conjecture is False
outside_sum_counterexample.relevance: Included to distinguish the outside-sum statement from this inside-sum task.

ai_assisted_search_report.provenance: The paper describes AI-assisted search at (4,4,3) among listed configurations and tests Schatten 2. It reports no construction improving the identity upper bound. It does not identify a distinct n=4,d=3 Schatten-2 witness for that search outcome.
ai_assisted_search_report.evidence_state: Reported search outcome only. The score-1 identity witness is independently reconstructed from the traditional construction.

independent_quantity.method: SymPy complex matrices and trace(M.H*M); independent exact product norms and finer rational root enclosures
